title: Surf Lessons in Myrtle Beach, South Carolina
requirements: Suitable for all physical fitness levels
You MUST be able to swim
Please wear a bathing suit and bring a towel. Sun protection such as sunscreen is strongly advised
Lessons are not private however the price does vary based on the number of guests per booking
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: For added fun and memories that will last a lifetime, take either a 1- or 2-hour surf lesson in Myrtle Beach! With side-by-side guidance, your instructor will show you the ins and outs of surfing to prepare you for the rest of your trip. Your board is provided, just bring your bathing suit for a great time catching some waves.
